from collections import Counter
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import statistics
import subprocess
import tempfile

ROOT=Path('/root/.codex/worktrees/f396/medaka')
BASE=Path('/tmp/medaka-queue-ablation-dcd09a442')
RESULTS=ROOT/'test/gc_prototype/results'
ARMS=['baseline','candidate','boehm_caller_inline','boehm_inline']
PROFILES=['ephemeral','list','tree','mutation','atomic','mixed','sizes']
DYNAMIC={'elapsed_seconds','preparation_seconds','process_peak_rss_bytes'}
def sha(path): return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def analyze(label):
    path=RESULTS/('2026-10-12-queue-5m-'+label+'.jsonl')
    records=[json.loads(line) for line in path.read_text().splitlines()]
    header,rows=records[0],records[1:]
    assert header['baseline_commit']=='dcd09a442850838ba56acb6fc426c9fed0234666'
    assert header['arms']==ARMS and header['profiles']==PROFILES and header['repeats']==8
    assert len(rows)==224
    assert Counter((row['backend'],row['profile'],row['repeat']) for row in rows)==Counter((arm,p,r) for arm in ARMS for p in PROFILES for r in range(8))
    assert all(row['execution_order']==ARMS[row['repeat']%4:]+ARMS[:row['repeat']%4] and row['execution_order'][row['execution_position']]==row['backend'] for row in rows)
    assert all(sorted(row['execution_position'] for row in rows if row['backend']==arm and row['profile']==profile)==[0,0,1,1,2,2,3,3] for arm in ARMS for profile in PROFILES)
    assert header['count']==5_000_000 and header['nursery_bytes']==(262136 if label=='offset' else 262144)
    groups=0
    for profile in PROFILES:
        for repeat in range(8):
            group={row['backend']:row['sample'] for row in rows if row['profile']==profile and row['repeat']==repeat}
            assert len({(row['allocations'],row['payload_bytes'],row['checksum']) for row in group.values()})==1
            baseline={key:value for key,value in group['baseline'].items() if key not in DYNAMIC}
            assert baseline=={key:value for key,value in group['candidate'].items() if key not in DYNAMIC}
            groups+=1
    for row in rows:
        count=5_000_000; sample=row['sample']; profile=row['profile']
        assert sample['count']==count and sample['profile']==profile
        assert sample['allocations']==count+(profile=='mutation') and sample['checksum']==count*(count-1)//2
        expected_payload=(count//8*sum((2,3,7,16,63,64,65,127))*8 if profile=='sizes' else sample['allocations']*24)
        assert sample['payload_bytes']==expected_payload
    for arm in ARMS:
        assert sha(Path(header['build_commands'][arm][-1]))==header['binary_sha256'][arm]
    for variant,source in header['source_paths'].items():
        path_source=Path(source)
        assert {p.name:sha(p) for p in path_source.iterdir() if p.is_file()}==header['source_sha256'][variant]
    assert sha(BASE/'correctness/result.json')==header['correctness_sha256']
    assert sha(ROOT/'runtime/medaka_rt.c')==header['runtime_sha256']
    assert sha(BASE/'control.py')==header['runner_source_sha256']
    assert header['libgc']['boehm_linkage']=='static'
    assert sha(Path(header['libgc']['boehm_archive']))==header['libgc']['boehm_archive_sha256']
    for variant,generated in header['adapter_hashes'].items():
        directory=Path(header['build_commands'][variant if variant!='boehm_reference' else 'boehm_inline'][-1]).parent
        assert sha(directory/'boehm_caller.h')==generated['caller_inline_header_sha256']
        assert sha(directory/'boehm_adapter.c')==generated['boehm_adapter_source_sha256']
    frozen=subprocess.run(['git','show',header['baseline_commit']+':test/gc_prototype/gc.c'],cwd=ROOT,check=True,capture_output=True).stdout
    assert hashlib.sha256(frozen).hexdigest()==header['source_sha256']['baseline']['gc.c']
    patch=header['variant_patches']['candidate']
    assert hashlib.sha256(patch['unified_diff'].encode()).hexdigest()==patch['sha256']
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='queue-reconstruction-') as temporary:
        directory=Path(temporary); (directory/'gc.c').write_bytes(frozen)
        (directory/'change.patch').write_text(patch['unified_diff'])
        completed=subprocess.run(['patch','-s','-p1','-i',str(directory/'change.patch')],cwd=directory,text=True,capture_output=True)
        assert completed.returncode==0,completed.stderr
        assert sha(directory/'gc.c')==header['source_sha256']['candidate']['gc.c']
    assert sha(ROOT/'test/gc_prototype/gc.c')==header['source_sha256']['candidate']['gc.c']
    per_profile={}
    for profile in PROFILES:
        arms={}
        for arm in ARMS:
            samples=[row['sample'] for row in rows if row['backend']==arm and row['profile']==profile]
            times=[row['elapsed_seconds'] for row in samples]
            summary={'min_seconds':min(times),'median_seconds':statistics.median(times),
                     'max_seconds':max(times),'range_seconds':max(times)-min(times),
                     'median_process_peak_rss_bytes':statistics.median(row['process_peak_rss_bytes'] for row in samples)}
            if arm in ('baseline','candidate'):
                summary['deterministic_stats']={key:value for key,value in samples[0].items() if key not in DYNAMIC}
                summary['copied_payload_over_nursery_payload_fraction']=samples[0]['copied_payload_bytes']/samples[0]['nursery_payload_bytes']
                summary['final_live_payload_over_total_payload_fraction']=samples[0]['exact_live_payload_bytes']/samples[0]['payload_bytes']
            else:
                summary['median_boehm_heap_bytes']=statistics.median(row['boehm_heap_bytes'] for row in samples)
                summary['median_boehm_heap_minus_free_bytes']=statistics.median(row['boehm_heap_minus_free_bytes'] for row in samples)
            arms[arm]=summary
        best_median=min(ARMS[2:],key=lambda arm:arms[arm]['median_seconds'])
        best_min=min(ARMS[2:],key=lambda arm:arms[arm]['min_seconds'])
        per_profile[profile]={'arms':arms,
            'candidate_over_baseline_median_ratio':arms['candidate']['median_seconds']/arms['baseline']['median_seconds'],
            'candidate_over_baseline_min_ratio':arms['candidate']['min_seconds']/arms['baseline']['min_seconds'],
            'fastest_Boehm_by_median':best_median,'fastest_Boehm_by_min':best_min,
            'candidate_over_fastest_Boehm_median_ratio':arms['candidate']['median_seconds']/arms[best_median]['median_seconds'],
            'candidate_over_fastest_Boehm_min_ratio':arms['candidate']['min_seconds']/arms[best_min]['min_seconds']}
    return {'label':label,'artifact':str(path),'artifact_sha256':sha(path),'header':header,
            'checks':{'all_224_sample_rows_preserved':True,'4arms_7profiles_8rounds_complete':True,
                'each_position_visited_twice_per_arm_profile':True,'all_semantic_identities_match':True,
                'full_custom_counter_equality_comparisons':groups,'source_binary_adapter_runtime_libgc_hashes_match':True,
                'candidate_patch_reproduces_exact_hash':True,'candidate_matches_implemented_gc_c':True},
            'per_profile':per_profile}
def main():
    audits=[analyze(label) for label in ('offset','aligned')]
    assert audits[0]['header']['source_sha256']==audits[1]['header']['source_sha256']
    assert audits[0]['header']['build_commands']==audits[1]['header']['build_commands']
    result={'experiment':'queue-fast-path-ablation','date':'2026-10-12',
        'method':'Four arms, seven profiles,5M allocations/profile, eight fresh-process cyclic rounds per arm at262136/262144 bytes; each of four execution positions occurs twice. Both minima and medians/ranges are descriptive, not statistical significance.',
        'checks':{'both_artifacts_pass':True,'all_448_sample_rows_preserved':True,
            '112_full_custom_counter_comparisons_equal':True,'same_frozen_sources_binaries_and_build_commands_both_capacities':True},
        'harness_source':{'runner_sha256':sha(BASE/'control.py'),'runner_fulltext':(BASE/'control.py').read_text(),
            'summarizer_sha256':sha(Path(__file__)),'summarizer_fulltext':Path(__file__).read_text()},
        'small_correctness':json.loads((BASE/'correctness/result.json').read_text()),
        'audits':audits,
        'limitations':['Standalone synthetic collector experiment; no compiler or application GC speedup is established.',
            'Heap initialization and shared layout prewarming are excluded from elapsed_seconds; final major collection is included.',
            'All assertions, counters, full prepared zero-initialization and nursery poisoning remain enabled.',
            'Caller-inline Boehm has matched prepared zeroing; historical adapter atomic allocation has no complete-zeroing promise.',
            'Inherited RSS floor prevents interpreting small process RSS differences as collector memory savings.',
            'Shares and timings must not be combined across different experiments into absolute-cost claims.']}
    target=RESULTS/'2026-10-12-queue-audit.json'; assert not target.exists()
    target.write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n')
    print(json.dumps({'audit':str(target),'checks':result['checks'],
        'median_ratios':{entry['label']:{profile:stats['candidate_over_baseline_median_ratio'] for profile,stats in entry['per_profile'].items()} for entry in audits}}))
if __name__=='__main__': main()

independent_audit.audit_script_fulltext:
import collections, difflib, hashlib, json, pathlib, statistics, subprocess

ROOT = pathlib.Path('/root/.codex/worktrees/f396/medaka')
BASE = pathlib.Path('/tmp/medaka-queue-ablation-dcd09a442')
RESULTS = ROOT / 'test/gc_prototype/results'
AUDIT = json.loads((RESULTS / '2026-10-12-queue-audit.json').read_text())
DYNAMIC = {'elapsed_seconds', 'preparation_seconds', 'process_peak_rss_bytes'}
ARMS = ['baseline', 'candidate', 'boehm_caller_inline', 'boehm_inline']
PROFILES = ['ephemeral', 'list', 'tree', 'mutation', 'atomic', 'mixed', 'sizes']

def sha(p):
    return hashlib.sha256(pathlib.Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()

def stable(row):
    return {k: v for k, v in row.items() if k not in DYNAMIC}

summaries = []
for label, nursery in [('offset', 262136), ('aligned', 262144)]:
    path = RESULTS / ('2026-10-12-queue-5m-' + label + '.jsonl')
    header, *rows = [json.loads(line) for line in path.read_text().splitlines()]
    recorded = next(x for x in AUDIT['audits'] if x['label'] == label)
    assert sha(path) == recorded['artifact_sha256']
    assert header == recorded['header']
    assert header['arms'] == ARMS and header['profiles'] == PROFILES
    assert header['nursery_bytes'] == nursery and header['count'] == 5000000
    assert header['repeats'] == 8 and len(rows) == 224
    keys = [(r['profile'], r['repeat'], r['backend']) for r in rows]
    assert len(set(keys)) == 224
    expected_order = [(p, rep, arm) for p in PROFILES for rep in range(8)
                      for arm in ARMS[rep % 4:] + ARMS[:rep % 4]]
    assert keys == expected_order
    lookup = {k: row for k, row in zip(keys, rows)}
    for p in PROFILES:
        for arm in ARMS:
            samples = [lookup[p, rep, arm]['sample'] for rep in range(8)]
            position_counts = collections.Counter(lookup[p, rep, arm]['execution_position'] for rep in range(8))
            assert position_counts == {0: 2, 1: 2, 2: 2, 3: 2}
            recorded_arm = recorded['per_profile'][p]['arms'][arm]
            times = [s['elapsed_seconds'] for s in samples]
            assert all(t > 0 for t in times)
            assert recorded_arm['min_seconds'] == min(times)
            assert recorded_arm['median_seconds'] == statistics.median(times)
            assert recorded_arm['max_seconds'] == max(times)
            assert recorded_arm['range_seconds'] == max(times) - min(times)
            assert recorded_arm['median_process_peak_rss_bytes'] == statistics.median(s['process_peak_rss_bytes'] for s in samples)
            if arm in ARMS[:2]:
                assert all(stable(s) == stable(samples[0]) for s in samples)
                assert recorded_arm['deterministic_stats'] == stable(samples[0])
            for rep, sample in enumerate(samples):
                row = lookup[p, rep, arm]
                order = ARMS[rep % 4:] + ARMS[:rep % 4]
                assert row['execution_order'] == order
                assert order[row['execution_position']] == arm
                assert sample['profile'] == p and sample['count'] == 5000000
                assert sample['allocations'] == 5000000 + (p == 'mutation')
                assert sample['checksum'] == 12499997500000
                payload = (5000000 // 8 * sum([2, 3, 7, 16, 63, 64, 65, 127]) * 8
                           if p == 'sizes' else sample['allocations'] * 24)
                assert sample['payload_bytes'] == payload
        for rep in range(8):
            assert stable(lookup[p, rep, 'baseline']['sample']) == stable(lookup[p, rep, 'candidate']['sample'])
        arm_summary = recorded['per_profile'][p]['arms']
        for statistic in ['median', 'min']:
            ratio_key = 'candidate_over_baseline_' + statistic + '_ratio'
            stat_key = statistic + '_seconds'
            assert recorded['per_profile'][p][ratio_key] == arm_summary['candidate'][stat_key] / arm_summary['baseline'][stat_key]
            best = min(ARMS[2:], key=lambda a: arm_summary[a][stat_key])
            assert recorded['per_profile'][p]['fastest_Boehm_by_' + statistic] == best
            assert recorded['per_profile'][p]['candidate_over_fastest_Boehm_' + statistic + '_ratio'] == arm_summary['candidate'][stat_key] / arm_summary[best][stat_key]
    for variant, hashes in header['source_sha256'].items():
        source = pathlib.Path(header['source_paths'][variant])
        assert {p.name: sha(p) for p in source.iterdir() if p.is_file()} == hashes
        for name, digest in hashes.items():
            if variant == 'baseline':
                data = subprocess.run(['git', 'show', header['baseline_commit'] + ':test/gc_prototype/' + name], cwd=ROOT, check=True, capture_output=True).stdout
                assert hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() == digest
        if variant == 'candidate':
            assert sha(ROOT / 'test/gc_prototype/gc.c') == hashes['gc.c']
    for arm, command in header['build_commands'].items():
        assert sha(command[-1]) == header['binary_sha256'][arm]
    assert sha(BASE / 'control.py') == header['runner_source_sha256']
    assert sha(BASE / 'source/baseline/run.py') == header['runner_sha256']
    assert sha(BASE / 'correctness/result.json') == header['correctness_sha256']
    assert sha(ROOT / 'runtime/medaka_rt.c') == header['runtime_sha256']
    assert sha(header['libgc']['boehm_archive']) == header['libgc']['boehm_archive_sha256']
    assert header['libgc']['boehm_linkage'] == 'static'
    for variant, hashes in header['adapter_hashes'].items():
        directory = BASE / 'build' / variant
        assert sha(directory / 'boehm_caller.h') == hashes['caller_inline_header_sha256']
        assert sha(directory / 'boehm_adapter.c') == hashes['boehm_adapter_source_sha256']
    patch = header['variant_patches']['candidate']
    assert hashlib.sha256(patch['unified_diff'].encode()).hexdigest() == patch['sha256']
    baseline_lines = (pathlib.Path(header['source_paths']['baseline']) / 'gc.c').read_text().splitlines(keepends=True)
    candidate_lines = (pathlib.Path(header['source_paths']['candidate']) / 'gc.c').read_text().splitlines(keepends=True)
    exact_diff = ''.join(difflib.unified_diff(baseline_lines, candidate_lines, fromfile='a/gc.c', tofile='b/gc.c'))
    assert exact_diff == patch['unified_diff']
    summaries.append({'label': label, 'rows': len(rows), 'full_counter_equalities': 56,
                      'sha256': sha(path), 'source_commit': header['baseline_commit']})
assert AUDIT['harness_source']['runner_fulltext'] == (BASE / 'control.py').read_text()
assert AUDIT['harness_source']['runner_sha256'] == sha(BASE / 'control.py')
assert AUDIT['harness_source']['summarizer_fulltext'] == (BASE / 'summarize.py').read_text()
assert AUDIT['harness_source']['summarizer_sha256'] == sha(BASE / 'summarize.py')
assert AUDIT['small_correctness'] == json.loads((BASE / 'correctness/result.json').read_text())
assert AUDIT['audits'][0]['header']['source_sha256'] == AUDIT['audits'][1]['header']['source_sha256']
assert AUDIT['audits'][0]['header']['binary_sha256'] == AUDIT['audits'][1]['header']['binary_sha256']
print(json.dumps({'independent_review': 'passed', 'sample_rows': 448,
                  'full_custom_counter_comparisons': 112, 'artifacts': summaries,
                  'new_workload_or_perf_runs': False}))
